HEADLINE: The new appointees
TEXT:
■ Vicki Meyer is the chief executive officer of Deniliquin Freighters and has more than 30 years’ experience in agribusiness. She also has an extensive background in the finance sector and knowledge of transport and water infrastructure.

■ Vonnette Mead is the operations manager of Meadcon and former Master Builders Australia Tasmanian branch board member. She is a member of the Tasmanian Building and Construction Training Board and a Latrobe councillor.

■ Amanda Cooper is a director of Urban Utilities in Queensland and a former Brisbane City councillor. She has a deep understanding of infrastructure planning and delivery, and urban planning and development.

■ Elizabeth Schmidt currently sits on the board of the Dalrymple Community Cultural Centre Trust and is a former mayor of the Charters Towers Regional Council. She has extensive experience in local government and in the transport sector.

■ Vanessa Guthrie AO has an extensive background in the energy, mining, communications and transport sectors. She is a non-executive director at Santos, Tronox, AdBri and Lynas, and former chair of the Minerals Council of Australia.

■ Robert Moffat is the chief executive officer of the Australasian Centre for Rail Innovation and vice-chairman of the International Railway Research Board. He has extensive experience in engineering and planning gained from a long career in the transport sector
